description: Watch competing and relevant clinical trials for your programs: registrations and changes (status, dates, enrollment, endpoints), readouts, results postings and stopped trials. One table of trials with sources, an events feed with a review queue and calendar, and a source report per run. Claude or ChatGPT does the searching, TrialAgents Intel (EU CTIS) first, then ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP and company releases, and a weekly scan + digest and high-impact alert keep it current.
whenToUse: Track clinical trials that matter to your programs (competitors, comparators, standard of care, your own trials as registered) and get told when something changes: new registrations, status, primary completion, enrollment or endpoint changes, results, readouts and stops, with sources and a weekly digest.
whenNotToUse: Running your own trials (sites, monitoring, CRO oversight, regulatory submissions), site or investigator selection (Site Finder, TrialAgents Intel research), competing assets beyond their trials (Pipeline Radar), papers and abstracts (Literature Radar), patents, deals, financings or regulatory items (their own radars), patient recruitment or anything that needs medical or legal advice.
